hotels.title: Outback Queensland Heritage Escape with Daily Breakfast, Sunset Drinks & Spa Treatments
hotels.description: Set in the outback town of Cunnamulla, at the crossroads of two major stock routes, this boutique stay captures the spirit of a bygone era. Known for enriching geothermal springs with artesian water, this boutique stay channels local character through heritage styled rooms and a relaxed, club-inspired atmosphere. The onsite restaurant dishes up delicious meals, and the bar pours cold drinks alongside stories from the locals. Ease into outback life with a treatment at the Club Boutique Day Spa, where the pace slows and the landscape does the rest. For the full hot springs experience, the new multi-million-dollar Cunnamulla Hot Springs, with seven mineral-rich pools, is just a five-minute walk away from the hotel. Live music nights and locally brewed craft beers bring the spirit of the old Club Hotel back to life, while the team run guided Out the Back Australia tours offer a deeper connection to the Channel Country.
